messages:
alex: heads up — I found ~200 duplicated billing events in hourly preview tied to yesterday's fallback rollout. looks like when requests hit the cheap-model fallback we emitted both the primary and fallback charge lines.

mira: ugh. can you paste an example event?

alex: here — truncated: 
```
request_id=rc-9f2a route=routeA model=redwood-large fallback_model=cheap-lite event_type=charge amount_tokens=120 charge_id=ch_83a
request_id=rc-9f2a route=routeA model=redwood-large event_type=charge amount_tokens=120 charge_id=ch_83b
```

alex: same request_id, two different charge_ids. dedupe should have prevented this.

sam: hypothesis: dedupe key is request_id + model_variant, and fallback swapped model_variant after we already emitted primary, so we ended up with two keys.

leila: right — the dedupe lives in ingest-transform and uses route_resolution_id + variant_tag currently. fallback path rewrites variant_tag mid-flight.

mira: does the console preview show both lines?

alex: yes — preview shows duplicate lines; invoices probably fine for most customers but previews/jira for SRE looked bad.

sam: quick mitigation: emit a fallback_origin tag on the first emitted charge and make dedupe key prefer request_id + fallback_origin if set. i can roll a tiny transform patch.

leila: will that cover all churn? what about in-flight KV cache where primary already committed?

sam: it will stop new dupes. existing duplicates need backfill/dedupe. i can add a small dedupe-cleaner job to reconcile by grouping on request_id and summing tokens, flag duplicates older than 10m.

mira: can we add a telemetry counter so we know if this recurs?

alex: yes please — add metric: billing.duplicate_detected by route and tenant and the new fallback_origin enum.

leila: one more thought — our rollout UI allowed toggling fallback on per-route canary. we should make the console warn when route-level fallback differs between canary and global. it led to partial-path behavior.

mira: agreed. UX follow-up ticket: console -> rollout page to surface per-route fallback mismatch and link to affected tenants.

sam: patch plan: 1) small transform change to set fallback_origin and use request_id-first as primary dedupe; 2) emit telemetry counter; 3) schedule dedupe-cleaner to backfill duplicates for last 24h; 4) console warning ticket. i can do 1+2 now, 3 tomorrow.

alex: pinging @billing-bot to create an incident preview note for finance so they ignore preview deltas while we backfill.

billing-bot: note created: INC-2026-preview-billing-dupes. finance alerted.

mira: small code snippet for transform (pseudo):
```
if event.fallback: event.tags.fallback_origin = event.fallback.reason || 'auto-route-fallback'
dedupe_key = join(':', event.request_id, event.tags.fallback_origin || 'primary')
```

leila: can we ensure dedupe window uses event.ingest_ts not emit_ts? past races were because emit_ts changed when fallback rewrote.

sam: good catch. will use ingest_ts.

alex: thanks team. after patch I'll run a dry-run of dedupe-cleaner on staging and share SQL used for audit.

mira: assign followups: ENG-4032 (transform patch), ENG-4033 (dedupe-cleaner job), ENG-4034 (console-rollout-warning).

leila: leaving a note for oncall: if you see invoice spikes, check INC-2026 and run the ad-hoc dedupe query (will post). :thumbsup:
